A '''battle''' of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], took place in the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]]. The Sith emerged as the victors in the battle.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of the Ottega system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" />
